text: Don’t you ever feel that about Eastern art? The colours are intoxicatingly lovely; but the shapes are mean and bad--deliberately mean and bad. I have seen wicked things in a Turkey carpet.” “Mon Dieu!” cried Flambeau, laughing. “They are letters and symbols in a language I don’t know; but I know they stand for evil words,” went on the priest, his voice growing lower and lower. “The lines go wrong on purpose--like serpents doubling to escape.” “What the devil are you talking about?” said the doctor with a loud laugh.
